title: Pagination: Extra small buttons (daisyUI)
notes:
Pagination is a group of buttons that allow the user to navigate between a set of related content.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/pagination/+page.md
